git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(orchestrator): aggregate usage across all tool rounds

Introduce aggregateUsage() helper function to sum token usage from
every provider call in a turn, not just the final round. The new
AggregatedUsage type makes the aggregation explicit in the interface.

When rounds report different usage, all are summed. When some rounds
lack usage, only reported rounds are counted. When no round reports
usage, the hook receives undefined (preserving current single-round
behavior for turns with no tools).

The afterModelResponse hook now receives a one-way aggregate that
consumers billing or budgeting from this hook will correctly account
for tool-heavy turns.

Acceptance tests in chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts verify
the aggregation logic. Existing regression test remains unedited.
EOF
)"
